newsitem.title: USA: Qualcomm ships over 6 mln MSM chips.
newsitem.headline: Qualcomm ships over 6 mln MSM chips.

text.p: Qualcomm Inc on Wednesday said it shipped more than six million of its Mobile Station Modem (MSM) chips to makers of digital wireless telephones based on the company's Code Division Multiple Access (CDMA) technology.

"We have been able to quickly and smoothly meet the very high volume demand for CDMA semiconductors," Donald Schrock, general manager of the ASIC business unit, said in a statement. "Because of these high volumes, we have been able to significantly reduce the MSM selling price to our customers."
The company said it was producing the chips at a monthly rate of about one million chipsets. First deliveries of new fourth-generation MSM chips are scheduled for late summer.
